answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 25 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the pearl solution is checked at the sable gate and logged, the jade audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
